entry: Seed list provided by the project initialization request.
screening_notes: Metadata and abstracts were inspected. No systematic database or citation search was performed in this initialization.
limitations: Abstract-level review only; no full-text review; no additional seed expansion.

entry: Full-text review of the two direct UAV candidates identified in the seed set.
source: arXiv HTML full-text and abstract pages
screening_notes: 2609.19961 is a position/architecture article with an illustrative LAESim use case and no standalone quantitative benchmark, HIL, or real-flight validation found. 2607.02277 is an actual landing-assessment method with simulation and hardware-in-the-loop evidence and no real-flight validation found; its venue/DOI metadata remains in conflict.
limitations: Only two direct UAV candidates are currently under review; the bounded target of roughly 6-12 candidates has not been reached. Reference tracking from seed papers was not systematically expanded in this iteration.

query_or_resource: Seed records in data/papers.json; no new database search executed
screening_notes: The seven-record seed set contains two direct UAV candidates: p-2609.19961 (position/architecture) and p-2607.02277 (method). The withdrawn record p-2510.22204 is provenance for p-2607.02277 and is not a separate candidate.
limitations: Do not treat this as an exhaustive 6-12 candidate search. Future iterations should prefer reference tracking from the full texts rather than abstract-only queries.

entry: Foundational neuro-symbolic papers, books, and community resources suggested for the auxiliary reference list.
query_or_resource: arXiv exact-title and ID lookups; Crossref bibliographic and DOI metadata lookups; SAIRLab ICRA 2025 workshop page
screening_notes: Added three foundational papers/monographs, four books/edited collections, and one robotics workshop as auxiliary resources. They are catalogued separately from UAV paper records and are not counted as core methods.
limitations: Book chapter contents and workshop papers were not individually screened. The workshop page was verified, but its OpenReview archive contents were not enumerated in this iteration.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: DeepProbLog exact title; Logic Tensor Networks exact title; "Scallop" "Differentiable" PLDI 2023
screening_notes: Added LTN and Scallop as auxiliary foundational methods after official/institutional and DOI metadata checks. Read selected introductory passages only; DeepProbLog remains a background paper, not a UAV method.
limitations: Selected passages do not justify fulltext_reviewed. Existing general surveys/books were not all reread.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: UAV drone neuro symbolic perception planning probabilistic logic NEUSIS; "SayPlan" "3D Scene Graphs" CoRL 2023
screening_notes: NEUSIS v1 method/experiments read and included; SayPlan metadata and selected method passages checked, classified as transferable mobile-manipulation work, not direct UAV evidence.
limitations: NEUSIS simulation assumes accurate maps/pose; SayPlan remains abstract_reviewed because the full extended manuscript was not read.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: "drone" "PDDL" "language model" planning; AutoTAMP exact title and arXiv; ProMis exact title and DOI
screening_notes: Included ProMis after main-text review and published DOI verification. AutoTAMP v3 main text read but remains candidate: principal evaluation in 2D, 3D drone supplement lacks semantic check, physical experiments use ground robots. AutoTAMP uses STL, not PDDL. ProMis predecessor arXiv:2406.03454 was a citation lead, not counted as a separate neural-coupling result.
limitations: ProMis offline geospatial experiments are not closed-loop flight; schema uses conceptual with this distinction explained in prose. Search was a targeted web/citation expansion, not an exhaustive database export.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: UAV drone neuro symbolic signal temporal logic language navigation; UAV "temporal logic" "neural" navigation learning; Verified compositions exact title
screening_notes: Added the CDC 2022 verified neural-controller composition study after reading its main method/experiment text. Read LLM-STL v1 method/evaluation and included with separate simulation and author-reported real-flight labels.
limitations: Reachability guarantees are conditional on model and initial-set assumptions; LLM-STL exact-match translation accuracy is not safety. No reproduction or independent flight-data audit.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: UAV neurosymbolic "shield" reinforcement learning; "UAV" "neuro-symbolic" "learning" verification; ASMA exact title; REVEL exact title
screening_notes: ASMA v4 abstract screened, final RA-L DOI confirmed; retained as boundary candidate pending audit of semantic coupling beyond CBF/MPC. NeuroSymLand v2 downloaded; retained previous 2026-09-20 full-text review and unresolved venue conflict. REVEL was a foundational safety lead, not added or treated as UAV evidence.
limitations: ASMA v1/v4 architectures differ; do not merge abstract claims across versions. No full-text review of ASMA or REVEL this round. This search does not establish the absence of other safety methods.

entry: Bounded literature expansion following foundations and five research themes.
query_or_resource: multi UAV neuro symbolic collaboration knowledge reasoning; "Learning-Guided Symbolic Solver Selection"; TypeFly exact title
screening_notes: Read TypeFly v2 and MINT v1 main texts and included both as human–UAV interaction methods. Corrected MINT venue to AAAI Spring Symposium Series using official publication metadata. Added SIMULTECH 2026 solver-selection paper as abstract-only candidate with DOI. CogMUS was a symbolic multi-UAV lead, not included without verified neural coupling.
limitations: Solver-selection PDF required login and was not downloaded or read. Human–UAV demonstrations do not establish multi-UAV coordination performance; MINT question counts are not a measured cognitive-load study.
